description: Bittensor EVM (Chain ID 964) activity monitor: recent blocks, transaction counts, gas used/limit, gas utilization %, and top smart contracts called across the window (1-20 blocks). Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_subtensor_weights_activity when you need recent validator weight-setting extrinsics on Subtensor; crypto_subtensor_block_events when you need events of a single Bittensor Subtensor block by block. Price: $0.005 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

blocks.description: Number of recent EVM blocks to analyze (1-20, default 5)
